front.title: ta. (TAA): Exact State Contraction and Source-Bound Exact-Computation Statements

abstract.t: This document defines the computer-science term ᑕ. (U+1455 U+002E), spoken TAA. It denotes exact state contraction: a replacement of a computational representation by a retained state that preserves a declared observation contract for every admissible input. The retained transition and observation maps commute with the full system, through a surjection onto the retained state, and this identity preserves every finite observation trace. The document also specifies a portable certificate for a checked result: a COSE_Sign1 statement with a deterministic CBOR payload that binds the exact artifact bytes to a registered predicate, its domain, a verdict, the exact checker implementation and the evidence. The statement can be registered with a SCITT Transparency Service. A signature authenticates the issuer's statement; a separate checker establishes whether the evidence supports it; a transparency receipt establishes registration, not mathematical correctness.
